description: Create the expanding-double-brackets.json topic file and generate both standard base PDFs (landscape + booklet) and VI-adapted PDFs.
steps: Step 1: Create topics/expanding-double-brackets.json with FOIL/grid method content, 8 graded questions, full booklet structure
Step 2: Add VI-adapted build mode to build.mjs (third arg 'vi' injects large-print CSS overlay and visible aria descriptions)
Step 5: Verify all 4 PDF files exist
acceptance_criteria: topics/expanding-double-brackets.json exists and is valid JSON matching the schema of introduction-to-algebra.json
The topic JSON contains 8 questions covering expanding double brackets with FOIL method, ramping from difficulty 1 to 5
The visual aid uses type 'grid' showing the area model for expanding (x+3)(x+2)
Running `node build.mjs topics/expanding-double-brackets.json` produces dist/Expanding-Double-Brackets-Landscape-Base.pdf and dist/Expanding-Double-Brackets-Base.pdf without errors
Running `node build.mjs topics/expanding-double-brackets.json dist vi` produces VI-adapted PDFs with larger fonts and high contrast
All 4 PDF files exist in dist/ after both build commands complete
verification: Run `node build.mjs topics/expanding-double-brackets.json` and confirm exit code 0 and PDFs written
Run `node build.mjs topics/expanding-double-brackets.json dist vi` and confirm exit code 0 and VI PDFs written
Run `ls -la dist/Expanding-Double-Brackets*` to confirm all 4 files exist and have non-zero size
findings: All 4 PDFs generated successfully. Standard base landscape: 82KB, standard booklet: 176KB, VI-adapted landscape: 66KB, VI-adapted booklet: 99KB. No regressions to existing introduction-to-algebra build.
